profile.headline: Software Engineer Staff at Lockheed Martin Space
profile.summary: Software Engineer with extensive experience and success in requirements definition, design, development, testing, technical presentations, and proposal requests.

positions.title: Software Engineer Staff
positions.description: Software Developer on Artemis/Orion, Diamondback, P441, P321, and Symphony Programs using Python, Plato, COMET/CCL, Java, and C++ in Linux environments.

positions.title: Systems Engineer Staff
positions.description:
Directed Requirements Development & Test Execution for Integrating acquired companies (ACS, QinetiQ) onto the SION Network.  Developed the RVTM, Created Test Procedures, and Managed Test Execution through System Integration Test (SIT) and User Acceptance Test (UAT) events; Tracked Defects and followed development through to resolution..

Test Lead responsible for the validation and verification of CIO Tools and Services prior to deployment to the enterprise.

company.name: Vencore Inc.  (formerly The SI Organization, Inc.)

positions.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for test design and test execution for the XFINITY iPad interface to Guide program in an Agile Environment.  Actively Supported Regression Test Execution and Defect Workoff.  HP Quality Center; Rally

positions.title: Systems Engineer Staff
positions.description:
GeoScout Test Lead; Led the team through successful customer acceptance test activities.  Wrote and tracked Discrepancy Reports for problem resolution for buyoff from the customer.  Led Daily Customer Status meeting.  Supported Customer Acceptance Testing at Customer Integration Test Facility (ITF).  Provided on-site support at Customer facilities during transition to operations.

Developed the Requirements Allocation Matrix (RAM) for the Valiant Angel Full Motion Video (FMV) project; Configured hardware & software for FMV prototype.

Developed DoDAF Views and Scenarios using the System Architect tool for the TAURAS Unmanned Systems IR&D.  Wrote Systems Level Requirements in DOORS based on these views.  Generated Formal Requirements Documents for Engineering Review Boards (ERBs).  Worked with the Chief Engineer to develop the Ops Concept and Capabilities Matrix, which was used to drive the System-of-System Requirements document.

Defined and Implemented the GPS III Program Library structure on the WGC (Work Group Collaboration) site, enabling the team to have rapid and easy access to military & commercial standards and LM authored specs and plans in a fast paced proposal environment; Supported users of WGC, IDE, and Program Library to increase their ability to efficiently access and use tools in the GPS III Program environment.

Authored and updated hardware, software and user guides and Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRLs) for the STIL and Valiant Angel programs including:  Services Integration Plan, Test & Evaluation Master Plan, Integrated Logistics Support Plan, Software Users Manual, Hardware & Software Configuration Guide.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provided Marketing, Requirements, Design, Development, Coding, Testing, and Support of Software Applications for Voice/Fax/Email Messaging Applications used by major communications companies in the United States and throughout the world.

Directed the development and implementation of a 4GL software and database system that processed and stored data for PLDs (programmable logic devices) and improved the efficiency of the engineering department's release time. 

Pioneered first self-directed work team that motivated employees to work together increasing productivity and customer satisfaction. Team focus was to develop and implement lean processes, increasing productivity and efficiency in the engineering organization.
 
Designed and programmed an engineering analysis tool that identified and reported critical electrical design rules violations, which significantly reduced the engineering and manufacturing costs of chips and printed circuit boards.

ClearPath A-Series MCP Algol DMSII LINC COBOL WFL CANDE NAP (Network Applications Platform)
